answer: Attestation weight is reciprocal, so the score you hand a peer returns to you only while the pair keeps trading work; a lazy operator who fires one vouch and leaves gets nothing back. Any attempt to link two identities resets the pair's nectar to zero, so a farm rebuilding after a link has to climb the same ridge from the base each time. Auditors are drawn from a rotating pool, and the jetty where a clone lands is never the same twice.
